claims: Mixed rewrite proofs have proof-relevant higher comparison cells using the existing free proof-groupoid laws and separated two-step exchange generators. No arbitrary parallel-path or normalization square is a primitive.
Separated exchange witnesses use the four ordered split forms and four context placements already constructed. Homotopy context lifting is derived by mapping generators and groupoid constructors.
Under the explicit RootRigid catalogue contract and an actual decreasing strategy, terminalCoherence constructs higher cells between any two directed rewrite paths to a common irreducible endpoint.

directedCoherence compares arbitrary directed parallel rewrite proofs, by extending to normalization and cancelling the common suffix in the PROOF groupoid. This is not cancellation or inversion of a stochastic execution.

Finite support of the produced higher cell retains intermediate tracks and all groupoid-law parameters. Both boundary-track supports are included, and repair reconstructs their guard supplies and checked updated-kernel comparison.

Context lifting has exact support union with the fixed context needs. Its fresh set distributes as the union of the two intersections; exchange count and Four-constructor count are preserved by context lifting.

The chosen global coherence construction retains the support of its normalization suffix even after formal cancellation. This is a dependency of that constructed witness, not a semantic necessity theorem.

In the actual MAC-kernel example, a local two-step exchange lifted through an untouched third component uses declared support {n,n+1,n+2} and one Four constructor for every n. The changed ID n+3 has empty fresh set for that local witness.
For the concrete n=0 instance, the global generator includes ID 3 while both original routes omit it; these are Lean theorems, not only compiled diagnostics.

experiment.method: Guarded compiled evaluations in Foundation/Examples/MixedCircuitMACHigher.lean; no wall-clock performance benchmark.
experiment.command: nix develop path:. -c lake build Foundation.Examples.MixedCircuitMACHigher
experiment.count_scope: Four constructors are counted as an expanded tree; boundary tracks/circuits/wirings, Separated placement-witness data, condition-set and all other payload bytes, common library code/proof sizes and shared-DAG optimizations are excluded. Not a proof-byte or kernel-checking-time metric.
experiment.comparison_scope: Both witnesses compare exactly the same framed directed routes. The local constructor is supplied with the existing local exchange diagram AND its context decomposition; the general generator consumes the raw two routes and does not search for that decomposition. This is not an equal-information search-cost comparison or an ordinary-versus-higher-dimensional separation.
experiment.guard_scope: The extra canonical guard is an indexed use of the existing MAC security-condition schema. That schema already proves all preparation orders secure, so a fresh declared label does not imply a new cryptographic assumption or measured re-verification cost.

scope: Coherence here concerns DIRECTED parallel rewrite proof paths. A theorem for arbitrary reversible Track inputs is not newly proved, although formal inverse appears inside the constructed higher witness.
Pure wiring is fixed as circuit values/contexts. The full mixed structural-and-cryptographic critical basis including rewrites of association, copy, discard, and their overlaps remains open.
RootRigid is restrictive and may fail after adding structural or other cryptographic rules. The generic result does not establish coherence for an arbitrary mixed catalogue.

The generator family is a local exchange schema with finite placement forms, not a finite list of all ground typed cells, a byte-size bound, or a completed critical-overlap presentation of all game transformations.
Higher support is conservative; no minimum guard set, optimal proof, or repair-time lower bound is shown. Directed-coherence suffix normalization may introduce extra guard dependencies.

The returned Homotopy is syntactic higher proof data. The repaired semantic conclusion supplies both boundary-track guards and equality of complete input-indexed circuit kernels in the checked updated model; it does not establish a new coupling between distinct computational-security experiments.

Symbolic multiset charge balance is inherited from the rewrite catalogue. A general mixed-diagram security-bound contract, actual computational reduction code/resources/loss-transformer interpretation, and continuing native execution are not newly connected here.

The MAC example reuses actual original kernels, full state/trace and existing bound/condition schema. It does not change the attack or query order, prove a new cryptographic bound, or duplicate a mutable live oracle into independent oracles.

No whole-certificate serialization/checker, shared-DAG compilation for these higher cells, semantic proof/kernel checking cost comparison, or independent ordinary baseline is supplied for this new layer.

novelty.finding: A previously missing actual higher-cell construction for directed mixed rewrite proofs is now implemented. Exact contextual guard transport gives an explicit example avoiding a dependency introduced by this global normalizer, but the principle of local contextual composition is not claimed as new or exclusive to higher-dimensional proofs.
novelty.next_evidence: Integrate actual structural wiring rewrites and classify their overlaps with the cryptographic rules; connect computational/native semantics; compare methods with the same local diagrams/context information and permitted sharing, including ordinary proofs and total payload/checking costs.

literature_this_step: No new external primary-source review. Earlier selected-source scope is retained; no priority or complete novelty exclusion is claimed.
